added_failures_note: Derived from completed opt-in-cpu/armed-base.log (18 passed, EXIT=0) and armed-head.log (24 passed, EXIT=0); both have no FAILED ids and the tested source/test blobs are identical at reviewed head.
assertion_audit: Continuation: certified plus exactly two calls fails if the driver stalls or accepts only one substep; first and second observed seeds 1.001 and 1.002 fail if predict_seed is bypassed.

Continuation: first factor absent and second factor identical to the first returned factor fail if forwarding is removed or the wrong call supplies the factor; this is cross-call plumbing observation, not a same-input tautology.
Default: certified/two calls and three absence checks fail if reuse is enabled implicitly or incoming factors leak through without opt-in; the recorded pre-fix reproduction is red.

Guarded solver: convergence and residual <=1e-10 fail for slope=4 or NaN if the retry branch is disabled, as the mutant log demonstrates; the residual-path equality only checks consistency between recorded and terminal residual.

Guarded solver: refactor counters and debug-callback build count fail if reuse always rebuilds, no rebuild occurs on refusal, or the counter disagrees with real Jacobian construction; factor_valid and independently expected identity matrix fail if the returned factor is missing or stale after rebuild.
Returned-factor test: first refactors=1, second=0 fail if the returned factor is discarded or not consumed; second convergence and residual fail if reusing it gives the wrong correction.
Measurement asserts exact imported source, GPU backend, x64 before arrays and requested lane width; each fails on a wrong tree, CPU fallback, single precision or insufficient saved lanes.
Per-slice measurement convergence/residual checks fail on any uncertified lane; no counters or timing claim can override them.

Suite wrappers check mutation-marker uniqueness, nonzero mutant exit and the intended failure id; zero or unintended failures cannot satisfy the negative control; paired failure-set checks fail on an added failure.

Report asserts completed scheduler/CPU receipts and EXITs, known mutant failure, complete 14-slice/8-lane data, digests and common inputs; damaged, incomplete, mismatched or unguarded evidence fails these checks.

Report precision uses inherited independent cross-arm arrays and locked constants; four deliberate perturbations exceed those constants and must all be refused, preventing uniform-zero output from being accepted without a positive control.
